title: A/P Summary: the filter row reads As of, Vendor, Past due, Location
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have open documents in these reports at two locations, so the Location chip shows.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/P Summary (Reports, then "A/P Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu).
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps: 1. Read the filter row under the title, chip by chip, left to right, letter for letter, capitals included.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Four chips, in this order: the date chip "As of: " and today's date (for example "As of: 10/15/2026"), the Vendor chip, the Past due chip, the Location chip.
  • The date chip says "As of", no longer "Date".
  • The Vendor chip reads "Vendor: All vendors" with a truck icon.
  • The Past due chip reads "Past due: Any" with an hourglass icon.
  • Both are in the resting (grey) style.
  • The Location chip reads "Location: All locations" with the location pin icon.
  • Every label matches exactly, capitals and punctuation included.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R1: “Each report's filter row is the native report filter row of the newer reports (Inventory Value, Sales By Customer), in this order on all six reports: the date chip ("As of: 10/15/2026"), the customer chip on the A/R reports or the vendor chip on the A/P reports, the Past due chip, then the Location chip.”
  • S5-R13: “The customer chip (A/R) and vendor chip (A/P) and their open menus are the native ones: Customer exactly as Sales By Customer's Customer filter (person icon), Vendor exactly as Inventory Value's Vendor filter (truck icon, "Search vendors"; as there, the search box shows only when there are more than 8 vendors). The menu has a search box, an "All customers" or "All vendors" row, the native line "All customers are included. Pick one or more to narrow." (or vendors) while none is ticked, and the list; several can be ticked. The chip reads "Customer: All customers" or "Vendor: All vendors" in the resting (grey) style when none is ticked, the name when one is (shortened with "..." when long), and "Customer: N customers" or "Vendor: N vendors" when N are. The ticked customers or vendors narrow every row, group, total, page, sort and export; the Location list does not change (S5-R3).”
  • S5-R15: “The Past due chip and its open menu are the same native checkbox dropdown as Customer and Location: label "Past due", an hourglass icon, an "Any" row, the native line "All ranges are included. Pick one or more to narrow." while none is ticked, then "1-30 days", "31-60 days", "61-90 days", "91+ days", in that order; several can be ticked. The chip reads "Past due: Any" in the resting (grey) style when none is ticked, the range when one is (for example "Past due: 91+ days"), and "Past due: N ranges" when N are. Ticking all four reads "Past due: 4 ranges", not Any, because Any also keeps invoices and bills that are not due yet. The ranges are the reports' own aging buckets: 1 to 30, 31 to 60, 61 to 90 and more than 90 days past the due date on the as-of date.”
  • S5-R6: “The chip reads "Location: All locations" when every location is ticked, the location's name when one is ticked (shortened with "..." when long), "Location: N locations" when N are ticked, and "Location: No locations" when none is.”
  • S5-R2: “The Location chip and its open menu are the native ones, exactly as on Sales By Customer, Inventory Value and Work In Progress: label "Location" with the location pin icon; the menu shows a "Select all" row, a "{N} selected" count, the locations with the ticked ones first, a search box with the placeholder "Search locations" once there are more than 8 locations, and "Clear selection".”
  • S5-R10a: “Filter choices are not remembered between visits: opening a report from the Reports menu starts on today's as-of date, no customer or vendor, Past due Any, and All locations.”
  • What changes for existing users: “The date filter is labelled "As of" (was "Date"). On A/R Collection and A/P Unpaid Invoices the Customer or Vendor chip now comes after it.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 4 "Location filter and Location column" (board Location.dc.html); page 7 "Filters and call list" (board Filters.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p7-the-native-vendor-menu.png: figure "The native Vendor menu" (New in this build), board "7. Filters and call list"
  • ar-ap-p7-four-chips-on-every-report.png: figure "Four chips on every report" (This build (after)), board "7. Filters and call list"
  • ar-ap-p4-opens-on-all-locations.png: figure "Opens on All locations" (This build (after)), board "4. Location filter and Location column"
  • ar-ap-p7-a-r-summary-date-only.png: figure "A/R Summary: date only" (Production (before)), board "7. Filters and call list" (today's look, for comparison only)

The design's own words:

  • "Vendor chip with the truck icon, as on Inventory Value. Its menu: a search box, "All vendors" ticked, "All vendors are included. Pick one or more to narrow.", then the vendors. S5-R13, S5-R14." (caption of "The native Vendor menu")
  • "As of, Customer (Vendor on A/P), Past due, Location. "Customer: All customers" and "Past due: Any" rest grey, Past due with the design system’s hourglass icon. S5-R1, S5-R13, S5-R15." (caption of "Four chips on every report")
  • "Native filter row: As of, Customer, Past due, then Location, which opens on "Location: All locations". Untouched, the report matches today. Column labelled "Location", after Date. S5-R1, S5-R2, S5-R5, S6-R1 to S6-R3." (caption of "Opens on All locations")
  • "The Summaries and Detail reports have no customer, vendor or past due filter today." (caption of "A/R Summary: date only")

Difference from the PRD (DD-02), closed: PRD version 5 said Vendor "exactly as Inventory Value's Vendor filter (truck icon, "Search vendors")" (S5-R13); the design shows the Vendor menu's search box reads "Search vendor" (singular); alt text: "Search vendor, All vendors and the helper line". PRD version 9 (23 Oct 2026), written after question 12, keeps "Search vendors" and adds that the search box shows only when there are more than 8 vendors (S5-R13); the singular "Search vendor" in the picture is not the requirement (Chris Ward's sheet row for question 12 repeats question 14's subject; PRD version 9 settles it). This case follows PRD version 9. The held design-version case D-77 (C715559) was deleted from TestRail on 26 Oct 2026 with the QA lead's go-ahead (snapshot in v9-pass-2026-10-26/deleted/).
